article_title: China's Chip-Material Makers Move on Japan's Turf as Guangyuan Commits $1 Billion to T-Glass for AI Servers

content_preview.title: China's Chip-Material Makers Move on Japan's Turf as Guangyuan Commits $1 Billion to T-Glass for AI Servers
content_preview.summary: Guangyuan is spending $1 billion on T-glass and low-dielectric glass cloth, pushing a Chinese supplier into a niche long dominated by Japan's Nittobo as AI-server demand tightens supply.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

Chinese electronic-materials maker Guangyuan New Material has committed US$1 billion to a factory in Henan Province to expand output of T-glass and low-dielectric glass cloth, according to [TrendForce](https://www.trendforce.com/news/2026/07/03/news-chinas-chip-material-suppliers-challenge-japanese-dominance-guangyuan-invests-us1b-in-t-glass/). The investment pushes a Chinese supplier into a corner of the chip supply chain that Japan's Nittobo has long dominated, [TrendForce](https:...

Every paragraph is inline-attributed to a specific TrendForce URL, and the piece appropriately confines forward-looking commentary to the labeled Analysis section.

NVIDIA, Microsoft, Google, and Amazon'. source-2.html.gz (TrendForce, 2025-11-28 Nittobo/Nan Ya) CONFIRMED verbatim: 'Nittobo is the world's only company capable of stably mass-producing top-grade T-Glass', 'prevents substrate warpage during advanced packaging ... improving AI chip yield', and Nan Ya 'by 2027 ... responsible for weaving 20% of the specialty glass-fiber fabrics that Nittobo supplies to the global market'.
